title: lastrea hirsuta

It is native to tropical Asia and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of Lastrea hirsuta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
